translated_title: The Blockade Against Cuba Doesn't Harm Its Government, but Its People; We Will Always Support Self-Determination: Sheinbaum
original_title: El bloqueo contra Cuba no daña a su gobierno, sino al pueblo; siempre apoyaremos la autodeterminación: Sheinbaum
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: In one of her twenty calls with Trump, Sheinbaum told him Cuba has already opened its economy and urged him to take that into account.
